The data tree is live and git-excluded; nothing in it can be validated or cited until ALL_DONE and SHA256SUMS exist and the records are committed or stored.

E2 (frozen-design defect, affects P8 and identity_check.py): the rule 'pkm_grid_fp_mults_uncharged = 1,248 x trials' is wrong by construction. The pipeline skips repeated targets before the oracle is called: in T12, proj-a lookups == trials - repeated_targets_skipped in 32/32 runs, and the F4 arm's branch counts fit 16 x (trials - skipped) calls in 32/32 runs with skipped > 0 in 31/32 runs (mean 208 of 7,061 trials, 2.94%). The exhaustive engine emits exactly 1,248 per oracle call (grid(.., first_only=false)), so the correct identity is 1,248 x (trials - repeated_targets_skipped). P8 as frozen will fail on essentially every pair; under PROTOCOL section 5 it must be reported as failed, with the corrected identity in a dated addendum, not retuned. The same overcount enters the section 2 model cells (grid and mitm per-trial work use trials instead of oracle calls): corrected points grid/F4 = 0.0238 / 0.0236 (protocol 0.0245 / 0.0243), F4/grid = 42.0 / 42.4 (40.7 / 41.1), grid/proj-a = 175 / 1,049 (181 / 1,081), grid/rho-neg = 1,444 / 8,923 (1,488 / 9,194), mitm/proj-a = 2.33 / 2.96 (2.33 / 2.99) at w = 0.1 / 1. No P2/P4/P5/P6 threshold is affected; the exploratory interval [0.020, 0.030] still covers.

E3 (README): cites data/run.log as evidence of the launch; the file does not exist (run.sh writes it only through log(), which has not been called). env.txt and chunks/driver.log do carry the launch time.
E4 (PROTOCOL section 2 prose): 'verify 23' for the F4 arm's phase GAE; the T12 mean is 21.94 (per-run values 14-28; design/cells.json says 21.9375).

E5 (PROTOCOL section 2 model-reason prose): 'approx. 2 x 32^2 / 2 approx. 2,000 signed pair sums' is arithmetically 1,024; the intended count is 4 x C(32,2) = 1,984 (or approx. 2 x 32^2). The measured 69.8 trials/relation = r/1,879 is consistent with approx. 1,900 effective sums. Not load-bearing for any rule.

E6 (scripts/run.sh, forward): finish() writes SHA256SUMS before appending end_utc to env.txt, touching ALL_DONE and writing the final log line to run.log and run.out; at completion `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` will fail on env.txt, run.log and run.out. Regenerating the manifest after finish is a change to the finished tree and must be recorded as such in the report.

E7 (artifact policy, forward): data/ is excluded from git (.git/info/exclude, 'TEMP') and has no .artifacts.json; the records cannot be a committed artifact set until pushed through the store or committed.

E8 (scripts/pooled_compare.py, latent): unpriced() does not exempt NON_OPERATION_COUNTERS (band.rs byte counters).
